title: Notes tab: replace List with VStack to avoid nested scroll conflict
description: In MeetingDetailView.notesTab, the List is inside the parent ScrollView causing potential nested scroll issues. Replace List with a LazyVStack or VStack inside a ScrollView to match the pattern used by other tabs (transcriptView, summaryTab).

title: Menu bar record/stop toggle
description: Move AudioRecorder into AppState so it can be controlled from both the menu bar dropdown and the main window. Add record/stop button with elapsed timer to MenuBarView. Forward recorder objectWillChange through AppState so UI stays in sync.

title: Add GCS bucket setting
description: Add googleBucketName to AppState (@AppStorage). Add plain TextField (not SecureField) for 'GCS Bucket Name' to SettingsView. Validate non-empty bucket before starting transcription in AppState.stopAndProcess() — surface user-friendly error if empty. Pass bucket to GoogleSpeechService.

title: Sidebar live notepad (Option A)
description: In MeetingListView, below the record button row, show a compact note-entry area when appState.recorder.isRecording: a TextField bound to appState.liveNoteDraft and an Add button (or Return key) that calls appState.addLiveNote(). Show the last 2-3 captured notes as a mini preview list below. Hide entirely when not recording.

title: Switch to longrunningrecognize with polling
description: Replace transcribeChunk()/splitIntoChunks() with single longrunningrecognize call using GCS URI. POST speech.googleapis.com/v1/speech:longrunningrecognize, get operation name. Poll speech.googleapis.com/v1/operations/{name} every 5s with 15-minute timeout. Handle done:true with error field explicitly. On success, pass response.results to existing parseSegments(). Remove timeOffset parameter from parseSegments since whole file is now one request.

title: Audio playback for recordings
description: Add playback controls to MeetingDetailView (play/pause, scrub bar, time display). Use AVPlayer or AVAudioPlayer with the stored audio file path.

title: AppState: liveNotes published state + note capture
description: Add @Published var liveNotes: [MeetingNote] = [] and @Published var liveNoteDraft: String = '' to AppState. Add func addLiveNote() that stamps current recorder.elapsedTime, appends to liveNotes (reject empty/whitespace). Pass liveNotes into both success and failure Meeting saves in stopAndProcess(). Reset liveNotes after save.

title: Reliable recording with drop detection and notifications
description: AVAudioEngine can silently stop on interruption or audio route change. Install observers for AVAudioSession interruption and route changes. If recording stops unexpectedly, show a system notification and attempt to restart. Never silently drop audio.

title: GCS delete after transcription
description: Add deleteFromGCS(filename:bucket:) async to GoogleSpeechService. DELETE https://storage.googleapis.com/storage/v1/b/{bucket}/o/{percentEncodedName}?key={apiKey}. Use defer in transcribe() so delete runs on both success and failure paths. Log 404 and other delete failures, never throw.

title: Remove chunking code
description: Remove splitIntoChunks(), transcribeChunk(), chunkDuration, tempChunkURL(), chunk temp-file logic. Remove timeOffset param from parseSegments/groupWordsIntoSegments. transcribe() becomes linear: upload -> longrunningrecognize -> poll -> parse -> delete. Build must pass with no warnings from removed code. Fold into 55b implementation.

title: GCS upload in GoogleSpeechService
description: Add uploadToGCS(audioURL:bucket:) async throws -> String to GoogleSpeechService. POST to https://storage.googleapis.com/upload/storage/v1/b/{bucket}/o?uploadType=media&name={urlEncodedFilename}&key={apiKey} with WAV data as body, Content-Type: audio/wav. Return gs://{bucket}/{filename}. Propagate non-200 response body in error.

title: Speaker management — rename, dismiss, line reassignment
description: In MeetingDetailView, add UI to: (1) rename speakers (Speaker A -> 'me', Speaker B -> 'David'), (2) dismiss phantom speakers, (3) select individual transcript lines and reassign to a speaker. Changes should update the transcript display immediately.

title: MeetingNote: zero-pad minutes in formattedTimestamp (03:05 not 3:05)
description: Change format string in MeetingNote.formattedTimestamp from '%d:%02d' to '%02d:%02d' so output is consistently mm:ss (e.g. 03:05, 12:30).

title: Improve GCS delete logging: distinguish 404 from other failures
description: In deleteFromGCS(), add a specific log branch for statusCode == 404 (e.g., 'object already deleted/not found') and keep the generic >=300 log for all other failures. Ref: Codex review of OnlyNotes-ct4.

title: MeetingNote model + Meeting.notes field
description: Add struct MeetingNote: Identifiable, Codable, Hashable { id: UUID, timestampOffset: TimeInterval, text: String } to Meeting.swift. Add var notes: [MeetingNote] = [] to Meeting. Use custom Codable init or decodeIfPresent so existing meetings.json still decodes without notes field. Add formatted timestamp helper mm:ss.

title: Main area live notepad panel (Option B)
description: In ContentView or MeetingDetailView, when no meeting is selected AND isRecording, show a full notepad panel in the main area: list of all liveNotes (mm:ss - text) + text field to add more. Same appState bindings as sidebar — they stay in sync automatically.

title: Auto-regenerate summary when speaker context changes
description: After any speaker rename/dismissal/reassignment, re-run GPT-4o summarization with the updated speaker-labeled transcript. Update summary, title, and action items in place. Show a loading state during regeneration.

title: Include notes in OpenAI summary prompt
description: Extend OpenAIService.summarize(segments:speakers:notes:) to accept [MeetingNote]. If notes non-empty, append a 'User Notes (recording-relative):' block to the prompt with formatted timestamps. Update both initial processing in AppState.stopAndProcess and manual regenerateSummary in MeetingDetailView to pass meeting.notes.

title: Add Google Cloud Speech-to-Text for transcription + speaker diarization
description: Replace OpenAI Whisper with Google Cloud Speech-to-Text v1 API. Use speaker diarization (enableSpeakerDiarization, minSpeakerCount/maxSpeakerCount). Set languageCodes to support en-US, kn-IN, ta-IN for code-switching. Store transcript as array of segments with speaker tags. Update Meeting model, MeetingStore, and SettingsView (Google API key field).

title: Export meeting notes
description: Allow exporting a meeting as Markdown or plain text. Include title, date, summary, action items, and transcript with speaker labels. Use NSSavePanel for file destination.

title: AI chat per meeting
description: Add a Chat tab to MeetingDetailView. Chat is scoped to the meeting transcript. User can ask freeform questions (e.g. 'what did David say about the budget?'). Maintain chat history per meeting, persisted in MeetingStore. Use GPT-4o with the full transcript as context.

title: Live notepad during recording with timestamped notes
description:
While a recording is in progress, let the user jot down scratch notes. Each note is timestamped relative to the recording start (e.g. '3:42 - ask about pricing'). Notes are saved with the meeting and included in the AI summary prompt so the summary reflects the user's in-call context. Notes should also be visible in MeetingDetailView after the call.

DESIGN DECISION: Support both sidebar inline (Option A) and main-area panel (Option B). Both sync to the same @Published liveNotes on AppState, so they stay in sync automatically. Single-screen users use sidebar; multi-screen users use the main panel.

title: Notes tab in MeetingDetailView + export
description: Add a Notes tab to MeetingDetailView segmented control. Show meeting.notes as a list of mm:ss - text rows. If notes is empty, show a placeholder. Include notes section in Markdown export.
